result.summary: Backports build and CI changes from PR #36927 to the 31.x maintenance branch. It removes CMake developer-level warnings treated as errors (`-Werror=dev` and `errors: {dev: true}`) from the `dev-mode` CMake preset and CI commit-test scripts, and updates the release notes for v31.x.
result.problem: Treating CMake developer warnings as errors in developer presets and CI scripts can cause builds and CI runs to fail when newer CMake versions or system configurations produce new developer warnings on the 31.x maintenance branch.
evidence: Clean backport of PR #36927 ('build: remove *dev* errors from dev-mode'), which was previously merged into the 32.x branch.
result.scope_notes: Backport PR targeting the 31.x release branch. While the diff includes unrelated changes due to divergence from master, the PR itself consists of only 3 backport commits affecting 5 files (+3/-4).
result.card: Backports build and CI updates from PR #36927 to the 31.x release branch, removing CMake -Werror=dev flags from the dev-mode preset and commit-testing CI scripts. This prevents new CMake developer warnings from breaking builds or CI runs for developers working on the maintenance branch. The change mirrors already-merged upstream commits and updates the v31.x release notes.

risk.why: Mistakes in CMake developer warning flags or CI scripts could fail build configurations on the 31.x branch but cannot affect consensus or node runtime.
